sc_cat_item.name: Temasek – AWS Innovation Sandbox Account (Assign / Release)
sc_cat_item.short_description: Request assignment or release of an AWS Innovation Sandbox account via the ISB platform.
sc_cat_item.description:
Submit a request to be assigned a new AWS Innovation Sandbox for experimentation, prototyping, or training purposes. Once approved, the system will automatically provision your sandbox via the Innovation Sandbox on AWS (ISB) APIs, add you to the required IAM Identity Center user group, and return your login URL and access details.
You may also use this catalog to release (terminate) an existing sandbox assignment.
